name: Cody Price
source:
Bitten by a radioactive shark, Cody Price gained the power to control water! Also shark teeth, and a sweet fin on his head. For a long time, he hid his powers, but now he really needs a job, and so he's become... Riptide!

[From the in-game character profile]
